A-1-X-P.name: Complex Strategic Decision
A-1-X-P.description: Should the company pivot? Should I switch careers? Should the city build a subway?
A-1-X-P.reason: Strategic decisions fear treating symptoms not root causes. Contradiction Analysis finds the real problem (principal contradiction), Strategic Foresight ensures you see beyond the immediate (foresee trends), Systems Thinking prevents tunnel vision (holistic view). All three are indispensable.
steps:
Step 1: List all problems (Contradiction Analysis)
  -> Write down all problems and conflicts you face
  -> Don't filter, write everything

Step 2: Distinguish primary/secondary (Contradiction Analysis)
  -> Which problem pulls one hair and moves the whole body?
  -> Which problem solved makes others auto-relieve?
  -> That's the principal contradiction

Step 3: Draw the big picture (Systems Thinking)
  -> Map the principal contradiction and all related factors as a relationship diagram
  -> Mark which are positive feedback (amplifying), which are negative feedback (suppressing)
  -> Find the leverage points in the system

Step 4: Simulate the future (Strategic Foresight)
  -> If Option A, what happens in 1/3/5 years?
  -> If Option B, what happens in 1/3/5 years?
  -> List best/worst/most likely for each

Step 5: Decide
  -> Choose the option with clearest principal contradiction and most controllable global impact
  -> Make contingency plans
expected: Decisions shift from gut feel to analysis
See 3-5 years ahead
Know what matters, ignore noise
A-1-X-P.case:
A traditional retailer faces e-commerce disruption.
Contradiction Analysis: Surface problem is online stealing business; principal contradiction is offline cannot provide value that online lacks.
Systems Thinking: Offline assets are space+people+immediacy; online assets are data+scale+convenience.
Strategic Foresight: Pure online gets platform-locked, pure offline slowly dies, integration is the way.
Decision: Transform stores to experience centers, online does data-driven recommendations, offline does experience+delivery. In 3 years, offline experience stores become brand moat.

A-1-X-R.name: Long-term Strategic Layout
A-1-X-R.description: Long-term strategic layout, 10-year corporate plan, 10-year personal growth
A-1-X-R.reason: Long-term layout is about survive and thrive. Protracted War Thinking plans three stages (defense->stalemate->counteroffensive), Encircle Cities from Countryside finds niches giants ignore, Gradual Reform ensures progress each stage.
steps:
Step 1: Assess strength (Protracted War)
  -> Honestly assess resource gap vs opponent
  -> If gap >5x, enter defense stage
  -> If gap 2-5x, prepare stalemate
  -> Only if gap <2x, consider counteroffensive

Step 2: Find weak market (Encircle Cities)
  -> Where does opponent serve poorly?
  -> Which customer segments are ignored?
  -> Pick a niche opponent ignores or does badly

Step 3: Build base (Encircle Cities)
  -> Become #1 in that niche
  -> Accumulate reputation, capital, talent
  -> Don't rush to expand, secure the base first

Step 4: Expand gradually (Encircle Cities)
  -> Radiate from base to adjacent markets
  -> Each expansion <=50% of current size
  -> New market must be profitable in 6 months

Step 5: Wait for timing (Protracted War)
  -> When you reach 30-50% of opponent size
  -> Opponent notices you
  -> Enter stalemate: defend + accumulate
  -> Keep deepening your advantage areas

Step 6: Counteroffensive (Protracted War)
  -> When you exceed opponent in a domain
  -> Concentrate resources to attack
  -> One core domain at a time
expected: Foothold in 1 year
Niche advantage in 2-3 years
Capacity to compete head-on with giants in 5 years
A-1-X-R.case:
Pinduoduo rose under Alibaba/JD duopoly.
Encircle Cities: Alibaba/JD focused on tier 1-2 cities, Pinduoduo started from tier 3-4 and rural.
Protracted War: Massive subsidies early, no profit, accumulated users.
Gradual expansion: From agri-products to full category, from sinking market upward.
Result: Became China's 2nd largest e-commerce platform.

A-1-Y-P.name: Business Competition
A-1-Y-P.description: New product launch facing competitors, market share battle, price war
A-1-Y-P.reason: Business competition is not who hits harder, but who thinks smarter. Total Victory Mindset reminds you: best competition is no competition (differentiation), Mental Models help understand competitive landscape from multiple angles, Mobile Warfare says: don't fight every battle, concentrate force on winnable ones.
steps:
Step 1: Know self and enemy (Total Victory)
  -> List your strengths, weaknesses, resources
  -> List competitors' strengths, weaknesses, resources
  -> Find battles opponent must win but you don't need to

Step 2: Multi-angle analysis (Mental Models)
  -> Economics: supply/demand, marginal cost, network effects
  -> Psychology: user decision biases, anchoring
  -> Ecology: species niches, ecological positioning
  -> Military: center of gravity, supply lines, high ground

Step 3: Find your niche (Total Victory)
  -> Where does competitor perform worst?
  -> Can you be best in that market?
  -> If yes, that's your ecological niche

Step 4: Concentrated attack (Mobile Warfare)
  -> All resources on chosen niche
  -> Become absolute #1 in that market
  -> Don't spread thin to other markets

Step 5: Build moat
  -> Brand, network effects, switching costs as barriers
  -> Make it hard for competitors to enter your niche
expected: Avoid head-on price war
Build absolute advantage in niche
Win by differentiation not attrition
A-1-Y-P.case:
A Chinese phone brand vs Apple/Samsung duopoly.
Total Victory: Don't fight on flagships, start with mid-low end.
Mental Models: Network effects (social), anchoring (value), economies of scale.
Mobile Warfare: Concentrate on camera, become best in price segment.
Result: From low-end to high-end breakthrough.

A-1-Y-S.name: Market Research
A-1-Y-S.description: Pre-entry market research, competitor analysis, user personas
A-1-Y-S.reason: Market research fears subjective speculation. Seek Truth from Facts ensures facts over assumptions, Mass Line ensures hearing real user voices not reports, Abstract Induction extracts core patterns from messy data.
steps:
Step 1: Define research goals (Seek Truth)
  -> Clarify 3 core questions
  -> Set time/budget/sample limits

Step 2: Go to frontline (Mass Line)
  -> Shadow support team 3 days, log complaints
  -> Surveys + deep interviews
  -> Don't ask what you like, ask what pains you most

Step 3: Identify core needs
  -> Top 3 mentioned needs
  -> Filter fake needs (say they want but don't use)

Step 4: MVP development (Gradual Reform)
  -> 2 weeks to minimum viable
  -> Budget <=10% of total
  -> Only core-need features

Step 5: Launch + collect data (Feedback Loops)
  -> Positive feedback (more users->more content->more users)
  -> Negative feedback (more users->noise->quality users churn)

Step 6: Continuous iteration
  -> Weekly small releases
  -> Each version incorporates user feedback
expected: Product-market fit improves
Iteration speed 3x faster
Retention significantly higher
A-1-Y-S.case:
A SaaS company wants AI features but doesn't know what.
Flexible Strategy: List 10 AI scenarios (smart support, auto-reports, recommendations).
Gradual Reform: 2 weeks, 3 MVPs, 50 seed users each.
Natural Selection: Smart reports usage 5x others, highest willingness to pay.
Result: Cut other 2, focus on smart reports, core differentiator in 6 months.

A-1-Y-Q.name: Institution Design
A-1-Y-Q.description: Design performance reviews, promotion mechanisms, corporate governance
A-1-Y-Q.reason: Institution design is not just writing rules, but designing a self-regulating system. Procedural Justice ensures fairness, Game Theory designs incentives, Feedback Loops predicts long-term effects.
steps:
Step 1: Clarify institution goal
  -> What problem to solve? (Incentive? Fairness? Efficiency?)

Step 2: Design process (Procedural Justice)
  -> Nomination->Review->Publicity->Appeal, each step has rules

Step 3: Simulate game (Game Theory)
  -> If institution is like this, how will people respond?
  -> Any loopholes to exploit?

Step 4: Predict feedback (Feedback Loops)
  -> What positive feedback will this trigger?
  -> What negative feedback?

Step 5: Pilot in small scope
  -> One department first
  -> 3 months evaluate, adjust, then scale
expected: Institutional fairness significantly improved
Gaming behavior reduced
Employee satisfaction increased
A-1-Y-Q.case:
A company designs new performance review.
Procedural Justice: Nomination->Review->Publicity->Appeal, each step has rules.
Game Theory: Simulate responses, found collusion loophole, added cross-dept review.
Feedback Loops: Predicted short-termism negative feedback, added long-term incentive weight.
Result: Fairness up, gaming down, satisfaction up.

A-2-X-P.name: Investment Decision
A-2-X-P.description: Whether to invest in a project? How to adjust asset allocation?
A-2-X-P.reason: Investments biggest enemy is yourself. Marginal Thinking helps rational allocation (last dollar ROI), Loss Aversion identifies emotional traps, Dual-System Thinking forces rational analysis on big decisions.
steps:
Step 1: Marginal analysis (Marginal Thinking)
  -> Not total return, but marginal return
  -> Where does last dollar earn highest ROI?

Step 2: Identify emotional traps (Loss Aversion)
  -> Refusing to stop loss because already down?
  -> FOMO chasing highs?

Step 3: Forced cooldown (Dual-System)
  -> Any large investment above threshold: 24hr wait
  -> Write decision rationale AND bear case

Step 4: Diversify + Focus
  -> Core (60%) in most certain direction
  -> Satellite (40%) in high-potential directions
expected: Impulsive trades reduced 70%+
Annual return volatility lower
Decision quality from gut to analysis
A-2-X-P.case:
An investor faces add-to-position decision.
Marginal: Where does last 100k earn best?
Loss Aversion: Found self refusing stop-loss due to sunk cost.
Dual-System: 24hr cooldown, wrote bear case.
Result: Avoided chasing high, bought dip on pullback, 15% better annual return.

A-2-Y-P.name: Negotiation
A-2-Y-P.description: Business negotiation, salary negotiation, M&A negotiation
A-2-Y-P.reason: Negotiation is not who hits harder, but who thinks smarter. Total Victory: best competition is no competition (differentiation), Game Theory designs incentives for cooperation.
steps:
Step 1: Know self and counterparty (Total Victory)
  -> List both strengths, weaknesses, resources
  -> Find what they must win but you don't need to

Step 2: Design mechanism (Game Theory)
  -> If negotiation is this way, how will they respond?
  -> How to structure terms so they feel cooperation is optimal?

Step 3: Design BATNA
  -> Your BATNA (best alternative)?
  -> Their BATNA?

Step 4: Concession list
  -> Things you give cheap but they value high
  -> These are your negotiation chips

Step 5: Concession in steps
  -> Don't show all cards at once
  -> Each concession extracts real counter-concession
expected: Avoid passive acceptance of bad terms
Hold ground on core interests
Build long-term partnership not one-off deal
A-2-Y-P.case:
A company renews contract with major client.
Total Victory: Don't fight on price, trade service upgrade for renewal.
Game Theory: Tiered service + incentive rebate, guides client to long-term.
Result: 3-year renewal, price -5% but total value +30%, both satisfied.

A-2-Y-R.name: Long-term Competition (Resources Tight)
A-2-Y-R.description: Startup vs giant, individual in industry, resource-constrained long competition
A-2-Y-R.reason: Resource-tight long competition is about survive and thrive. Encircle Cities finds niches giants ignore, Guerrilla Tactics enables flexible maneuver, Gradual Reform ensures progress each stage.
steps:
Step 1: Assess strength (Protracted War)
  -> Honestly assess resource gap
  -> Gap>5x: defense
  -> Gap 2-5x: stalemate prep
  -> Gap<2x: counteroffensive prep

Step 2: Find weak market (Encircle Cities)
  -> Where does giant serve poorly?
  -> Which customers ignored?
  -> Pick market giant ignores

Step 3: Build base (Encircle Cities)
  -> Become #1 in niche
  -> Accumulate reputation, capital, talent
  -> Don't rush expansion, secure base first

Step 4: Expand gradually (Encircle Cities)
  -> Radiate to adjacent markets
  -> Each expansion <=50% current size
  -> New market profitable in 6 months

Step 5: Wait for timing (Protracted War)
  -> At 30-50% opponent size, enter stalemate
  -> Keep deepening advantage areas

Step 6: Counteroffensive (Protracted War)
  -> When exceeding opponent in a domain
  -> Concentrate resources to attack
  -> One core domain at a time
expected: Foothold in 1 year
Niche advantage in 2-3 years
Head-on capacity vs giants in 5 years
A-2-Y-R.case:
A SaaS startup vs Salesforce monopoly.
Encircle Cities: Salesforce targets enterprise, startup from SMB.
Guerrilla: Free tier early, build user reputation.
Gradual expansion: CRM -> marketing automation, SMB upward.
Result: Vertical #1, acquired by big tech.

A-3-Y-R.name: Breakout from Disadvantage
A-3-Y-R.description: Extremely resource-poor, disadvantaged position, need turnaround
A-3-Y-R.reason: Extreme disadvantage only way out: avoid strength hit weakness, flexible maneuver, self-reliance. Encircle Cities finds gaps opponent ignores, Flexible Strategy adapts fast, Self-Reliance ensures no external bailout dependence.
steps:
Step 1: Admit gap, no head-on
  -> Honestly assess: where absolutely weaker?
  -> Abandon battles you must win but can't

Step 2: Find gaps (Encircle Cities)
  -> Where does opponent serve worst?
  -> Which customers completely ignored?
  -> Pick domain opponent doesn't even care about

Step 3: Flexible maneuver (Flexible Strategy)
  -> No fixed playbook, strike where open
  -> They defend A hard, you attack B
  -> When they react to B, you're already at C

Step 4: Self-reliance (Self-Reliance)
  -> Don't expect external funding/partnership to save
  -> Cash flow must be self-generated
  -> Core tech/capability must be self-developed

Step 5: Accumulate counteroffensive capital
  -> Become #1 in chosen domain
  -> Accumulate cash, talent, tech moats
  -> Wait for opponent mistake or environment shift, then total attack
expected: Foothold in niche in 6 months
Cash flow positive in 1-2 years
Counteroffensive capacity in 3-5 years
A-3-Y-R.case:
Vertical SaaS vs Salesforce.
Admit gap: No full CRM, abandon enterprise.
Find gaps: Focus on medical aesthetics clinic management (Salesforce ignores).
Flexible: Scheduling first, then inventory, then marketing tools.
Self-reliance: Customer prepayments fund ops, no VC.
Result: Vertical #1, reverse entry into general SaaS.

B-2-Y-S.name: Technical Breakthrough
B-2-Y-S.description: Core tech bottleneck, algorithm optimization, architecture refactor
B-2-Y-S.reason: Technical breakthrough is not linear progress, but long accumulation + sudden paradigm shift. Flexible Strategy avoids single-path lock-in, Punctuated Equilibrium reminds breakthroughs come from paradigm shifts, Self-Reliance ensures core tech independence.
steps:
Step 1: Multi-path exploration (Flexible Strategy)
  -> List 3-5 possible technical approaches
  -> Small resource pre-research each
  -> Don't put all eggs in one basket

Step 2: Spot paradigm shift (Punctuated Equilibrium)
  -> Watch new papers, frameworks, hardware
  -> Ask: any new paradigm makes old problem simple?
  -> e.g., Transformer made NLP from RNN obsolete

Step 3: Core self-reliance (Self-Reliance)
  -> Core algorithms/arch must be self-developed
  -> Key dependencies must have fallbacks
  -> Cannot be locked by single vendor/opensource

Step 4: Small fast validation
  -> Minimum prototype each direction
  -> Benchmarks speak, not intuition

Step 5: Focused breakthrough
  -> Resources to most promising 1 path
  -> Concentrate firepower on core challenge
expected: Avoid 6+ months wasted on wrong direction
Core tech self-controlled
Breakthrough speed 2-3x
B-2-Y-S.case:
An AI chip company cracks sparse compute acceleration.
Multi-path: Sparse matrix compression, dynamic pruning, knowledge distillation 3 paths.
Punctuated Equilibrium: Found sparse patterns auto-optimizable by compiler (paradigm shift).
Self-reliance: Core compiler self-built, not dependent on TVM/MLIR upstream.
Result: 60% latency reduction, 3x energy efficiency.

B-1-Z-S.name: Product Rapid Iteration
B-1-Z-S.description: Zero-to-one product, MVP validation, PMF search
B-1-Z-S.reason: Products aren't built in isolation. Flexible Strategy responds fast to market feedback, Feedback Loops builds growth flywheel, Gradual Reform iterates in small steps.
steps:
Step 1: Rapid hypotheses (Flexible Strategy)
  -> 5 core hypotheses (user needs X, pays Y, channel Z)
  -> Sort by validation cost, test cheapest first

Step 2: MVP (Gradual Reform)
  -> 2 weeks to minimum viable
  -> Budget <=10% total
  -> No admin backend, core interaction first

Step 3: Real user test (Feedback Loops)
  -> 20 seed users try
  -> Positive feedback (more users->more value->more users)
  -> Negative feedback (more users->worse exp->churn)

Step 4: Data-driven iteration
  -> Weekly release
  -> Each version changes 1-2 KPI features
  -> A/B test every change

Step 5: Build growth flywheel
  -> Identify loop (acquire->activate->retain->refer->acquire)
  -> Strengthen positive, cut negative
  -> Dashboard with daily north-star metric
expected: MVP live in 2 weeks
PMF validated in 1 month
Iteration speed 3x
B-1-Z-S.case:
Team building AI writing tool.
Rapid hypotheses: Users need outline generation not full text.
MVP: 2 weeks outline generator, 50 seed users.
Feedback Loops: Users love outline->fulltext one-click, 40% retention.
Rapid iteration: 1 template/week, 10k DAU in 3 months.

C-2-Y-P.name: Leadership Development
C-2-Y-P.description: IC to leader transition, new manager adaptation
C-2-Y-P.reason: Good leaders don't manage everything, they manage the right things. Mass Line ensures hearing truth, Wu Wei teaches letting go, Systems Thinking sees org holistically.
steps:
Step 1: Go to frontline (Mass Line)
  -> Half day/week with team
  -> Don't ask what's the problem, ask what blocks you
  -> Log: what makes them feel powerless, waste time, lack support

Step 2: Set goals and standards (Wu Wei)
  -> Only set goals/standards, don't dictate how
  -> Let team find their way
  -> Your job: remove obstacles, not direct moves

Step 3: Draw org map (Systems Thinking)
  -> Mark key roles, dependencies, info flows
  -> Find single points of failure (person leaves = system down)

Step 4: Rotation system
  -> Team members rotate as Tech Lead
  -> Grow next-gen leaders
  -> You gradually exit daily decisions
expected: Team autonomy increases
Leader freed from daily approvals
Org resilience strengthened
C-2-Y-P.case:
Tech director from IC to management.
Frontline: Half day/week code review + sit in meetings, ask what blocks not progress.
Wu Wei: Only set deliver X feature + 80% coverage, no tech direction.
Systems: Drew architecture deps, found auth service as single point, drove refactor.
Result: Team autonomous delivery up, he got time for strategy.

C-2-Z-P.name: Conflict Mediation
C-2-Z-P.description: Team internal conflicts, cross-dept friction, partner disputes
C-2-Z-P.reason: Conflict essence is unmet needs collision. Contradiction Analysis sees through phenomenon to essence, Framing Effect reframes to reduce antagonism, United Front redirects to shared goals.
steps:
Step 1: Separate private talks (Seek Truth)
  -> Talk to each party alone, no stance
  -> Ask: Core demand? Absolute bottom line?
  -> Log both core interests, red lines, emotional triggers

Step 2: Reframe (Framing Effect)
  -> Not who right/wrong, but what shared goal blocked?
  -> A vs B wrong -> we both want success, methods differ
  -> Zero-sum -> positive-sum

Step 3: Open dialogue (Contradiction Analysis)
  -> Face to face, you facilitate
  -> Each says: I understand their demand is...
  -> Find principal contradiction (usually 1 core disagreement)

Step 4: Third option (United Front)
  -> Not A compromise or B compromise, but 3rd way
  -> Find common enemy (competitor/deadline/tech debt)
  -> Turn internal conflict into external shared challenge

Step 5: Written agreement
  -> Who does what, deadline, breach handling
  -> Set review checkpoint (2 weeks)
expected: 1-2 sessions resolve most cooperation conflicts
Culture: conflicts can be constructive
Avoid talent loss, project delays
C-2-Z-P.case:
R&D vs Product over frequent requirement changes.
Contradiction: Core issue not many changes, but zero-cost changes.
Reframe: Who right/wrong -> how to make changes orderly.
United Front: Common enemy is delivery delay.
Agreement: Changes need PO sign-off + impact assessment, emergency fast-track with post-fix.
Result: Change throughput 3x, no more antagonism.

C-3-Y-S.name: Interpersonal Relations
C-3-Y-S.description: Workplace conflicts, managing up, cross-dept collaboration
C-3-Y-S.reason: 90% interpersonal issues stem from cognitive biases and framing misalignment. Cognitive Bias Identification reveals blind spots, Framing Effect changes response by changing expression, Dual-System reminds slow thinking before key conversations.
steps:
Step 1: Identify own biases (Cognitive Bias ID)
  -> Interpreting no reply as disrespect? (confirmation bias)
  -> Feeling owed because I gave much? (sunk cost)
  -> Write: how much of my judgment is fact vs inference?

Step 2: Reframe communication (Framing Effect)
  -> Not you always..., but when X happened I felt Y, I hope Z
  -> Accusation -> request, accusation -> shared goal
  -> E.g., you don't support me -> this project matters, I need specific support...

Step 3: Activate slow thinking (Dual-System)
  -> 10 min forced wait before important convo
  -> Write: my goal? their need?
  -> Rehearse: if they refuse, how I respond?

Step 4: Seek win-win
  -> Ask: what outcome good for both?
  -> Propose specific, low-cost, acceptable action
  -> Set review checkpoint
expected: Conflict escalation probability down 80%
Cross-dept collaboration significantly improved
Reusable communication templates established
C-3-Y-S.case:
PM vs designer over design delivery delay.
Bias ID: PM thought designer procrastinating, actually waiting upstream requirements.
Reframe: Why so slow -> we launch Friday, need lock Wednesday, what support you need?
Dual-System: PM cools 10 min, realizes anxiety projection.
Result: Designer delivered Wednesday, project on time.

D-1-Y-R.name: Personal Growth Planning
D-1-Y-R.description: Career planning, skill tree building, side hustle choice, lifelong learning
D-1-Y-R.reason: Personal growth is a marathon. Gradual Reform avoids overcommitment, Mental Models builds cross-domain framework, Natural Selection: try many, fail fast, keep what fits.
steps:
Step 1: Inventory current state (Seek Truth)
  -> Skill matrix: list skills, rate 1-10
  -> Time audit: where did last week go?
  -> Energy audit: what charges vs drains you?

Step 2: Build skill tree (Mental Models)
  -> Core skill (moat): 1 to top 10%
  -> Satellite skills (leverage): 3-5 at standard
  -> New domain exploration: 1 per quarter

Step 3: Small fast steps (Gradual Reform)
  -> Weekly micro-goal (read 1 chapter, write 1 article, practice 1 hr)
  -> Not perfection, done
  -> Retro: what learned this week? what change next?

Step 4: Natural Selection (Natural Selection)
  -> Quarterly review: what compounds? what depreciates?
  -> Keep compounding skills (writing, coding, English, investment thinking)
  -> Cut depreciating/no-feedback investments

Step 5: Build compounding system
  -> Input: 30 min/day high-quality
  -> Process: Feynman/zettelkasten/mindmap
  -> Output: 1 article/week or code
  -> Feedback: collect -> adjust input
expected: Clear skill radar in 1 year
Expert moat in 1 domain in 3 years
Sustainable lifelong learning system built
D-1-Y-R.case:
Programmer wants to pivot to AI.
Inventory: Coding strong, math weak, English average.
Skill tree: Core=Python+DL frameworks, Satellite=math+paper reading.
Gradual: 1hr/day papers+replication, weekend blog retros.
Natural Selection: 3 months quit RL (poor feedback), focus CV.
Result: Top conference paper in 1 year, pivot successful.

D-2-Y-R.name: Organizational Capability Building
D-2-Y-R.description: Engineering systems, R&D processes, talent pipeline
D-2-Y-R.reason: Org capability building is a protracted war. Protracted War stages it (foundation->system->results), Encircle Cities starts from strongest pain point, Gradual Reform ensures each step solid.
steps:
Step 1: Assess current (Protracted War)
  -> Honest eval: eng efficiency, code quality, delivery cycle, talent density
  -> If foundation very weak: defense (stop bleeding)
  -> If foundation okay: stalemate (build system)
  -> If foundation good: counteroffensive (benchmark)

Step 2: Find entry point (Encircle Cities)
  -> Which dept has strongest pain, strongest will, least resistance?
  -> Pick 1 dept as pilot, don't roll out all
  -> E.g., CI/CD in core business team first, then company-wide

Step 3: Build base (Encircle Cities)
  -> Pilot team runs: process, tools, standards, metrics
  -> Output: templates, automated pipelines, quality gates
  -> Verify: delivery faster, defects down, satisfaction up

Step 4: Expand gradually (Encircle Cities)
  -> Radiate from pilot to adjacent teams
  -> Each expansion <=50% current size
  -> New team must run process in 3 months

Step 5: Stalemate and counteroffensive (Protracted War)
  -> At 50% coverage: consolidate + optimize
  -> At 80%+: publish standards, enable others, build brand
expected: Core team runs eng system in 6 months
60%+ teams covered in 1 year
Industry-benchmarkable eng effectiveness in 2 years
D-2-Y-R.case:
Mid-size tech builds eng system.
Protracted War: Don't talk standards first, solve 2hr build pain.
Encircle Cities: Core transaction team pilot, CI/CD to 15min.
Gradual Reform: Pipeline first, then code standards, test coverage gates.
Gradual expansion: 1 team -> 3 teams -> 12 teams.
Counteroffensive: Published Engineering Effectiveness Whitepaper, industry benchmark.

D-2-Z-P.name: Crisis Response
D-2-Z-P.description: Major outage, PR crisis, key personnel loss
D-2-Z-P.reason: Crisis moments, Contradiction Analysis finds primary/secondary, Seek Truth forces facing truth, Redundancy Backup is last defense.
steps:
Step 1: Classify severity (Contradiction Analysis)
  -> Is this P0 (fatal), P1 (severe), P2 (general)?
  -> What is principal contradiction? Secondary?
  -> Who is decision maker? Executor? Informed?

Step 2: Stop bleeding (Seek Truth)
  -> Admit problem, no cover-up, no blame-shifting
  -> Take most direct stop-loss action
  -> E.g., outage->cut traffic/degrade/rollback; PR->apologize/publish facts/rectify

Step 3: Activate backup (Redundancy Backup)
  -> Critical paths have Plan B?
  -> Key person has backup?
  -> Data/service has geo-redundancy?

Step 4: Root cause retrospective
  -> 5 whys, dig to systemic root cause
  -> Distinguish: technical, process, management, culture causes
  -> Create action items: owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Step 5: Institutionalize
  -> Turn lessons into norms/tools/processes
  -> Drill: regular fault drills/crisis simulations
  -> Retro: next time same issue caught and stopped in minutes?
expected: P0 outage recovery <30 minutes
PR crisis 24hr turnaround
Same issue zero recurrence
D-2-Z-P.case:
An e-commerce big promo core transaction chain outage 15 min.
Contradiction: Principal contradiction is DB master write block, secondary is cache penetration.
Seek Truth: Admit outage, cut read-only mode stop loss, public apology.
Redundancy: Replica promoted to master, geo-backup restored data.
Root cause: Promo pre-heat script unrate-limited caused write storm.
Institutionalize: Pre-promo mandatory stress test, rate limit, circuit breaker trio.
Result: Next year promo zero outage, fault drill routine established.

D-3-Z-P.name: Survival Crisis
D-3-Z-P.description: Company near bankruptcy, project about to be cut, personal job loss/major illness
D-3-Z-P.reason: Survival moments tolerate zero fakes and delays. Seek Truth forces facing brutal reality, Contradiction Analysis finds the one lifeline in chaos, Redundancy Backup is last lifeline - critical paths must have alternatives.
steps:
Step 1: Face reality (Seek Truth)
  -> Stop all sugarcoating, delays, wishful thinking
  -> Write: how many months cash runway? core business survival?
  -> List all debts, commitments, hard costs

Step 2: Find the one lifeline (Contradiction Analysis)
  -> List all problems, find only the if-unsolved-tomorrow-we-die one
  -> Everything else paused, all hands on this one
  -> E.g., cash flow break is principal contradiction, strategy/culture/brand all yield

Step 3: Configure redundancy (Redundancy Backup)
  -> Critical paths must have Plan B, Plan C
  -> Cash: min 3 months operating reserve
  -> Key talent: critical roles must have backups
  -> Core business: must have degradation mode (e.g., manual/read-only fallback)

Step 4: Extreme focus execution
  -> Everyone only does survival-relevant work
  -> Daily standup: what did for survival yesterday? what today?
  -> Cut all non-cash-generating/non-life-saving projects/meetings/reports

Step 5: Find turning point

  -> Daily eval: which path has highest survival probability?
  -> Concentrate resources on highest-probability path
expected: Cash flow positive or funded in 30 days

B-1-Y-S.name: Innovation Breakthrough
B-1-Y-S.description: Tech innovation, business model innovation, disruptive innovation
B-1-Y-S.reason: Innovation is not linear, but mutation. Natural Selection reminds: many trials, fast iterations, keep what fits. Punctuated Equilibrium tells: breakthroughs often from paradigm shifts. Flexible Strategy lets you not dead-end on single path.
steps:
Step 1: Multi-path exploration (Natural Selection)
  -> Simultaneously try 3-5 different tech/business paths
  -> Each path small resource, clear stop-loss
  -> Don't put all eggs in one basket

Step 2: Spot paradigm shift (Punctuated Equilibrium)
  -> Watch: any new theory, tool, infrastructure emerging?
  -> Ask: can this change make previously "impossible" become "possible"?
  -> e.g., Transformer made NLP from RNN obsolete

Step 3: Rapid validation and screening (Flexible Strategy)
  -> Each path does minimum viability validation (MVP/prototype/experiment)
  -> Data speaks, not intuition
  -> Stop-loss: underperforming paths decisively cut

Step 4: Focused breakthrough
  -> Resources concentrate on most promising 1 path
  -> Concentrate firepower on core challenge
  -> Build tech/commercial moat

Step 5: Scale up
  -> On validated basis, rapid expansion
  -> Standardize, automate, platformize
  -> Form new growth curve
expected: Avoid 6+ months wasted on wrong direction
Establish multi-path exploration mechanism
Breakthrough speed 2-3x
B-1-Y-S.case:
A company wants to do AI drug discovery.
Natural Selection: Simultaneously explore molecule generation, protein folding, virtual screening 3 paths.
Punctuated Equilibrium: AlphaFold2 released, protein folding solved (paradigm shift).
Flexible Strategy: Decisively cut protein folding self-dev, leverage AlphaFold2 for downstream apps.
Focus breakthrough: Concentrate resources on molecule generation challenge.
Result: 6 months launched first candidate drug, entered pre-clinical.

C-1-Y-P.name: Team Building
C-1-Y-P.description: Forming new team, team integration, culture shaping
C-1-Y-P.reason: Team isn't ready just by hiring. Mass Line ensures hearing real voices, United Front helps integrate differences, Management by Objectives aligns everyone to goals.
steps:
Step 1: Deep understanding (Mass Line)
  -> 1-on-1 deep interviews each member
  -> Ask: what you excel at? want to do? worry about?
  -> Log: skill matrix, willingness matrix, concerns list

Step 2: Find consensus (United Front)
  -> Identify core values overlap
  -> Find "greatest common divisor" as team culture foundation
  -> Allow differences, but core must align

Step 3: Set goals (Management by Objectives)
  -> Jointly create OKRs, not top-down decomposition
  -> Goals challenging but achievable
  -> Establish weekly/monthly/quarterly review rhythm

Step 4: Establish mechanisms
  -> Weekly: sync progress, expose problems, mutual help
  -> Retro: victory retro, failure retro, all retro
  -> Feedback: timely, specific, actionable

Step 5: Continuous iteration
  -> Quarterly review: culture healthy? goals aligned?
  -> Adjust: people, process, incentives
  -> New member onboarding: culture package
expected: Team cohesion significantly improved
Goal alignment >90%
Per capita output up 30%+
C-1-Y-P.case:
A startup core team expanded from 5 to 20.
Mass Line: Founder 1-on-1 each, found "tech debt" biggest pain.
United Front: Established "User value first, Tech excellence, Radical transparency" three values.
MBO: All participate in quarterly OKRs, weekly public progress.
Result: 6 months delivered 3 core versions, zero major incidents, team satisfaction 4.8/5.

H-YLP-148.unique_thinking: 农业死磕+范式跃迁：以「矛盾分析法」定位「自花授粉=主矛盾、不育系=关键杠杆」，在生物学铁律的「非本质环节」（光温敏感性）找到突破口；以「笨功夫/死磕到底」建立「年种万份组合→逐粒观察→逐代筛选→负面清单归档」育种流水线，30 年累计杂交组合 20 万+；以「自然选择法+间断均衡法」利用「环境诱导不育」这一短暂剧变机制，绕过「基因型恢复系」刚性约束，实现「两系法」全品种可配的范式跃迁；以「驿站制/信息流速」建立「育种→试验→示范→推广→反馈」五级流速体系与南繁加代机制，将新品种从育成到大面积推广周期从 8 年压缩至 3 年。三系法→两系法→一系法/超级稻的「由繁至简、优势越来越强」战略阶梯，是其把单次育种胜利升维为可传承科学体系的标志性思维。

维基百科/百科全书「袁隆平」条目及 IRRI、国家 863 计划两系法专题史料
key_facts: 1930-09 生于江西德安；1953 毕业于西南农学院（现西南大学），分配至湖南安江农校任教
1964 起从事杂交水稻研究；在对一株「鹤立鸡群」野生杂交稻观察中获得灵感
1966 发表首篇论文《水稻的雄性不孕性》，提出「要想利用水稻杂种优势，首推利用雄性不孕性」，否定「水稻等自花授粉作物没有杂种优势」传统观点，创立杂交水稻学
1970 弟子李必湖等在海南南红农场发现「野败」（野生稻雄性不育株），为培育不育系找到有效途径（远缘杂交路径）
1973 实现不育系、保持系、恢复系「三系配套」，育成强优势组合「南优 2 号」，成为世界上第一位成功利用水稻杂种优势的科学家
1975 攻克制种关（国际水稻所 1971 起研、1973 放弃的难题），制种产量逐步提升至亩产 300 公斤+，为大面积推广奠基
1976 起全国推广，当年 208 万亩、增产 20%+；截至 2018 累计推广超 93 亿亩、增产稻谷 9300 多亿公斤
1986 发表《杂交水稻育种的战略设想》：方法上三系→两系→一系（由繁至简、效率渐高），优势水平上品种间→亚种间→远缘（优势渐强），被国内外同行广泛采用
1987 弟子李必湖、邓华风找到光敏不育水稻；同年「863」计划立两系法专题，袁任责任专家主持全国协作攻关
1989 罕见盛夏低温致全国性两系制种失败，两系法被「唱衰」；袁提出「选育实用光温敏核不育系不育起点温度低于 23.5℃」关键指标与核心种子生产程序/冷水串灌繁殖，使研究起死回生
1995 两系法杂交水稻研究成功（中国独创），比同熟期三系稻增产 5%~10%、米质改善，可大面积推广
1997 提出超级杂交稻超高产株型模式（高冠层、矮穗层、中大穗）与技术路线；2000/2004/2012/2014 实现百亩示范亩产 700/800/900/1000kg 第一至四期目标（云南个旧 2018 达 1152.3kg、最高 1209.5kg）
2017 世界粮食日前夕两系超级稻亩产 1149.02kg 创世界纪录；「种三产四」丰产工程等多养活数千万人
获首届国家最高科学技术奖、国家特等发明奖、联合国教科文组织科学奖、世界粮食奖等 30 余项；2019 获「共和国勋章」

mode_evidence.袁隆平_instantiation: 「铁律找缝隙」——在「水稻自花授粉、杂种优势利用难」的生物学铁律下，用矛盾分析法把「能否利用杂种优势」拆解为「主矛盾=自花授粉导致无法天然杂交」与「关键杠杆=雄性不育系」。其 1966 年论文一针见血：「首推利用雄性不孕性」，即绕开主矛盾的「本质环节」（自交结实），改在「非本质环节」——找到天然不育株——打开缺口。这正是「识别矛盾→区分主次→解决关键」的标准动作：把「不可能」重构为「只需攻克不育系一个关键点」。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与屠呦呦（同样用模式 1 定位「高温煎煮破坏活性成分」主矛盾）同法不同域：屠用于化学提取工艺反向设计，袁用于生物学铁律下的突破口定位，且袁把矛盾分析法前置为整个育种战略的起点（先于死磕与范式跃迁）。

mode_evidence.mode_name: 笨功夫/死磕到底（复利功夫）/ Compound Diligence
mode_evidence.袁隆平_instantiation: 「育种流水线死磕」——把模式 36「锚定技能→日更制度→复盘闭环→负面清单→传承机制」工程化为农业育种流水线：年种上万份杂交组合→逐粒观察→逐代筛选→把失败的基因型与气候组合列入「负面清单」归档，30 年累计杂交组合 20 万+。其「不在稻田里，就是在去稻田的路上」「搞杂交水稻的人，不经过水深火热是难出成果的」即「日更制度」；80 多岁仍一天下田三四回即「复利最强本金是笨功夫」的现身说法。1989 两系法危机时一句「要搞研究就不要怕失败，怕失败就不要搞科研」是死磕精神的极端样本。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与王选（激光照排汉字信息处理死磕，同为模式 36 第二人选）互证「农业死磕」范式：王选死磕在算法/硬件工程迭代，袁隆平死磕在生物材料万千组合的体力+时间复利；二人共证「时间与笨功夫是最强杠杆」，但袁把模式 36 大规模化、长周期化（30 年 vs 王选的工程周期）。

mode_evidence.袁隆平_instantiation: 「环境诱导不育=人工自然选择」——两系法的核心机制：光温敏核不育系在夏季长日照/高临界温（>23.5℃）下雄蕊不育、充当母本与任意品种杂交；在春秋短日照/低温下可育、自交繁殖保种，「一系两用」省掉保持系。袁把「自然选择→渐进演化→变异遗传」运用于在自然环境（光照、温度）中筛选并利用不育/可育的变异：不是改造基因，而是让自然的光温节律替他「选择」不育表型，再固定有利变异。配组自由（任意品种均可作父本）正是变异遗传自由度提升的结果。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与达尔文式/组织进化用法不同，袁把模式 23 从「被动观察演化」转为「主动利用环境诱导的表型变异做育种选择」，是工程化的自然选择——把自然环境当作巨型选择压力源。

mode_evidence.袁隆平_instantiation: 「短暂剧变→新稳态」的范式跃迁——两系法正是「长期稳定（三系法体系已成熟）→短暂剧变（1987 光敏不育发现 + 1989 低温危机倒逼）→选择压力（23.5℃ 指标与冷水串灌技术）→新稳态（两系法 1995 成功、全品种可配）」的间断均衡范本。袁利用「环境诱导不育」这一「短暂剧变机制」绕过了「基因型恢复系难找」的刚性约束，实现从三系到两系的范式跃迁；其后超级稻 700→800→900→1000kg 四级台阶亦是一次次的「稳定—突破—新稳定」。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与常规「技术创新阶梯」用法不同，袁的间断均衡带「危机驱动」特征：1989 盛夏低温本是灾难，却被他转化为重新定义不育起点温度的契机，使剧变成为跃迁的推力而非终点。

mode_evidence.mode_name: 驿站制/信息流速思维 / Relay Station / Information Velocity
mode_evidence.袁隆平_instantiation: 「南繁加代+五级流速体系」——把模式 41「驿站覆盖→情报网络→日行四百里」用于农业科研组织：以海南「南繁」为天然加代驿站，利用南北温差一年种两三代，把育种周期「信息流速」翻倍；建立「育种→试验→示范→推广→反馈」五级流速体系（国家级-省级-县级三级良种繁推体系），将新品种从育成到大面积推广周期从 8 年压缩至 3 年。数以万计制种大军云集海南、制种面积 3.3 万亩，即「驿站网络」规模化。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与周恩来/薛暮桥（同用模式 41 做治理/改革信息流速）不同，袁把模式 41 实体化为「地理驿站（南繁基地）+生物加代」——用纬度差制造时间流速差，是信息/生物流速思维的农业工程版。

proposed_steps: 第1步（模式 1 矛盾分析法）：铁律找缝隙——用矛盾分析定位「自花授粉=主矛盾、不育系=关键杠杆」，在生物学铁律的非本质环节（天然不育株/光温敏感性）打开突破口，否定「自花授粉作物无杂种优势」旧论
第2步（模式 36 笨功夫死磕）：育种流水线——建立「年种万份组合→逐粒观察→逐代筛选→负面清单归档」育种流水线，以 30 年 20 万+ 组合的时间复利替代天才式顿悟，把偶然突破变必然产出
第3步（模式 23 自然选择法）：环境诱导不育——用光温敏核不育系让自然环境（长日照/高温）替你「选择」不育表型：夏季制种、春秋自繁，一系两用省保持系，配组自由全品种可配
第4步（模式 24 间断均衡法）：范式跃迁——以「短暂剧变（光敏不育发现/低温危机）→选择压力（23.5℃ 指标+冷水串灌）→新稳态（两系法 1995 成功）」实现从三系到两系的范式跃迁；危机即跃迁推力
第5步（模式 41 驿站制信息流速）：加代推广网——用海南南繁驿站做生物加代提速，建「育种→试验→示范→推广→反馈」五级流速体系与三级良种繁推网，把育成到推广从 8 年压到 3 年
第6步（战略阶梯固化）：三系→两系→一系/超级稻——把单次胜利升维为「由繁至简、优势渐强」的可传承战略阶梯，写入育种指导思想，使范式可复制、可审计、可接力
expected: 三系法 1973 配套、1976 推广，截至 2018 累计推广 93 亿亩、增产 9300 多亿公斤，直接养活数千万/年
两系法 1995 成功（中国独创），比同熟期三系稻增产 5%~10%、米质改善，配组自由使选优组合几率大增、制种成本显著降低
「南繁加代+三级繁推体系」覆盖 2 亿亩/年，把新品种推广周期从 8 年压至 3 年，形成可传承的农业科研组织范式
战略阶梯（三系→两系→一系）被国内外同行采用，成为杂交水稻育种发展的指导思想
applications: 农作物育种战略设计（矛盾定位突破口 + 长周期死磕流水线）
生物表型利用型创新（环境诱导不育/自然选择工程化，绕开基因型刚性约束）
范式跃迁管理（危机驱动的间断均衡：把失败转为重新定义指标的契机）
科研组织提速（南繁式地理驿站加代 + 五级流速繁推体系，压缩研发—推广周期）
长周期国家战略科技（粮食安全自主、可传承科学体系构建）
种业工程化推广（三级良种繁推网、配组自由降低制种成本）

distinctiveness.vs_王选: 王选用 36 死磕激光照排算法/硬件工程；袁隆平和王选同为模式 36 第二人选，互证「农业/工程死磕」范式，但袁把死磕大规模化、长周期化（30 年 20 万+ 组合）并叠加 23/24 范式跃迁，王选侧重单点工程化突破
distinctiveness.vs_屠呦呦: 屠呦呦用模式 1 做化学提取工艺反向设计（低温乙醚破水煎路径依赖）；袁隆平用模式 1 做生物学铁律突破口定位，二人同法不同域，且袁把矛盾分析法前置为整个育种战略起点
distinctiveness.vs_薛暮桥/周恩来: 薛/周用模式 41 做改革/治理信息流速；袁用模式 41 实体化为「地理驿站（南繁）+生物加代」，用纬度差制造时间流速差，是农业工程版信息流速
distinctiveness.vs_吴有训: 吴用模式 9 做科学仪器自主（科研级）；袁不直接用 9，但其粮食安全自主与「中国独创两系法」隐含科技自主精神，可与吴形成「基础科学自主—应用育种自主」互补
distinctiveness.exclusive_contribution: Protreptic 中唯一把「矛盾分析法（铁律找缝隙）+ 笨功夫死磕（20 万+ 组合流水线）+ 自然选择/间断均衡（环境诱导不育的范式跃迁）+ 驿站制信息流速（南繁加代推广网）」熔于一炉的人物；模式 36 在「农业长周期死磕」场景的第二支柱，模式 23/24 在「生物育种范式跃迁」的低频补强第三人选

caveats: 袁隆平成就基于特定历史与制度条件（国家 863 计划、南繁基地、集体攻关），其「死磕流水线」不可简单移植到所有科研领域，须标注组织前提
一系法（杂种优势固定/留种）至今未大规模生产应用，留种效率仍低，勿将「三系→两系→一系」描绘为已完成闭环，应如实标注为「战略设想进行中」
杂交水稻种子价格通常比常规稻贵 10 倍以上，其「成本降低」指两系法相对三系法的制种成本降低，而非相对常规稻；表述须精确以免误导
「养活 8000 万+/年」为推广面积折算的估算口径，引用时应注明是推广效益而非袁个人单独产出

H-XMQ-151.description_en: Xue Muqiao（1904-2005）：薛暮桥将「价格=信息+激励」的信息论视角引入计划经济改革：提出「价格双轨制」(计划价+市场价并存)、「价值规律是社会主义经济规律」，并首创用「损失厌恶」框架解释改革阻力——改革创造的收益是分散的、长期的，而损失是集中的、即时的，因此必须设计「补偿机制」与「渐进容错」来对冲损失厌恶。其「必要的损失vs不必要的损失」区分，成为改革风险决策的核心启发式。
H-XMQ-151.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M26(损失厌恶思维), M19(边际思维法), M38(摸石头过河), M39(鸟笼经济), M41(驿站制/信息流速). 薛暮桥将「价格=信息+激励」的信息论视角引入计划经济改革：提出「价格双轨制」(计划价+市场价并存)、「价值规律是社会主义经济规律」，并首创用「损失厌恶」框架解释改革阻力——改革创造的收益是分散的、长期的，而损失是集中的、即时的，因此必须设计「补偿机制」与「渐进容错」来对冲损失厌恶。其「必要的损失vs不必要的损失」区分，成为改革风险决策的核心启发式。
steps_en: Step 1: 损失账单建模——用「损失厌恶思维」(模式26)列出改革各利益相关方的「即时损失清单」（量化金额/权力/地位损失），识别「集中损失群体」
Step 2: 补偿机制设计——用「边际思维」(模式19)设计「针对性补偿/过渡安置/利益分享」，使损失群体边际收益≥边际损失

Step 4: 信息流速监测——用「驿站制/信息流速」(模式41)建立「价格信号→企业决策→资源重配→反馈中央」高频反馈回路，将改革信号传递延迟压缩至月度级
Step 5: 必要损失区分——建立「必要的损失(制度转型必经)vs不必要的损失(设计失误/执行偏差)」判别标准，动态调整改革节奏

H-CY-159.name_zh: 陈毅：苏北/华中游击根据地四位一体建设、新四军统战与「诗军外交」跨界范式

H-CY-159.unique_thinking: 军政文跨界四位一体范式：以「游击战十六字诀」(模式 16) 把「敌进我退→敌驻我扰→敌疲我打→敌退我追」四阶段转译为「碎片化敌占区→连片根据地」的空间织网算法，在苏北/华中「敌强我弱、地盘割裂」条件下用机动积累力量、逐步连片建立政权；以「总体性思维」(模式 22) 将「政权建设+武装建设+经济建设+文化建设」四系统耦合为正反馈闭环（政权供给人员→武装保卫政权→经济供养武装→文化凝聚人心），把敌后根据地升维为可自我循环的社会治理系统工程；以「统一战线法」(模式 6) 推行「三三制」政权组成（共产党/非党进步分子/中间派各 1/3）与「抗日联合会」式广泛团结，把根据地的政治包容度最大化；以「框架效应法」(模式 31) 将「将军/诗人/外交官」三重身份重构为「文化使者」单一框架，用《陈毅诗稿》、书法与豪爽幽默作「非官方外交货币」，在万隆/日内瓦/联大舞台实现「文化破冰→政治对话→外交突围」的跨界复用；以「多元思维模型」(模式 17) 建立「军事指挥→政治建设→经济管理→文化传播→外交谈判」五域能力的「核心能力迁移矩阵」，把同一批人的军政文才干跨域复用。五环咬合为「空间织网→系统治理→政治包容→文化破冰→跨域复用」的军政文一体化范式，是 Protreptic 中「军政文跨界领导」的罕见标杆。

key_facts: 1901-08-26 生于四川乐至；1919 赴法国勤工俭学，1923 加入中国共产党，奠定其「军人+文人」双重底色

1958-1972 任外交部长 14 年；1955 以周恩来主要助手身份出席万隆亚非会议，1961 率团出席第二次日内瓦会议（老挝问题）并促成协议，1965 在北京发表著名中外记者招待会讲话表明中国严正立场

文革中同林彪、江青集团破坏外交的阴谋坚决斗争；1969 主持「四元帅国际形势座谈会」（陈毅、叶剑英、徐向前、聂荣臻）提出利用中美苏大三角矛盾、打开中美关系的前奏判断；1972-01-06 逝世

mode_evidence.mode_name: 游击战十六字诀 / Guerrilla 16-Character Tactics
mode_evidence.陈毅_instantiation: 「空间织网连片算法」——把模式 16「敌进我退→敌驻我扰→敌疲我打→敌退我追」从「战术机动口令」转译为「碎片化敌占区→连片根据地」的空间织网算法：在苏北/华中「敌强我弱、据点林立、地盘割裂」条件下，先用「敌进我退」保存核心力量与干部，用「敌驻我扰」切断日军交通线与伪政权补给，待「敌疲我打」之机拔据点、建乡级抗日民主政权，再「敌退我追」把孤立据点连成跨县连片根据地。三年南方游击战（1928-1937）与苏北反「扫荡」是其连续实战场，十六字诀在这里不是单次伏击的打法，而是「以机动换空间、以空间养政权」的根据地生长方程。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与粟裕（同为模式 16 人选，P0「非对称作战完整范式」、把十六字诀用于歼灭战与战役级机动）和毛泽东（模式 16 战略层面提出者与游击战总方针制定者）不同，陈毅把模式 16 从「作战机动」升维成「根据地空间织网/政权连片算法」——其十六字诀的施工产出不是一场胜仗，而是一张连片政权地图。他是 Protreptic 中模式 16 把「战术口诀→空间治理」转化的独特样本，补强「游击根据地建设」这一场景（与粟裕的纯作战范式互补不重叠）。

mode_evidence.陈毅_instantiation: 「四位一体根据地闭环」——把模式 22「反对碎片化、把对象当整体系统」用于敌后根据地建设：不孤立搞军事，而是把「政权建设+武装建设+经济建设+文化建设」四系统耦合为正反馈闭环——抗日民主政权（三三制）供给干部与动员人口→武装（正规军/地方武装/民兵三结合）保卫政权→根据地经济（公债/合作社/统购统销）供养武装→文化动员（抗日剧团/壁报/识字班）凝聚人心、反哺政权合法性。四系统互为输入输出，使根据地在封锁中能自我循环、自我造血，是把「总体性」用于「敌后社会治理系统工程」的完整展开。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与竺可桢（同为模式 22 人选，P1，把整体观用于「科教观测网络+气候-农业系统耦合」）不同，陈毅把模式 22 用于「敌后根据地的社会系统四支柱耦合」——其整体观的施工对象是「一个被封锁的微型社会」，治理目标是「在军事压力下的自我循环存续」，而非「科学观测体系的全局一致」。他是 Protreptic 中模式 22 在「战时社会治理系统工程」场景的低频补强标杆，与竺可桢共证「系统耦合」却分处科教与敌后治理两端。

mode_evidence.陈毅_instantiation: 「三三制政权包容最大化」——把模式 6「分析力量→找盟友→分化对手→保持主导」下沉到根据地基层政权结构：推行「共产党/非党进步分子/中间派」各占 1/3 的「三三制」政权组成，并通过「抗日联合会」团结开明士绅、地方实力派、知识分子与各抗日阶层，把根据地的政治包容度拉到当时敌后政权的最高水平；同时以新四军军纪与民主作风争取民心，分化「铁杆汉奸」与「可争取中间势力」。其统战对象不是远方的盟友，而是根据地内部每一类可团结的社会力量。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与刘少奇（模式 6 用于「党内斗争安内 + 党外攘外」双重统一战线）和周恩来（模式 6 用于国际统战与多边外交）不同，陈毅把模式 6 用于「敌后根据地政权的内部组成结构」——以三三制把统一战线写进政权成分本身，而非仅作外部策略。他是 Protreptic 中模式 6 在「基层政权政治包容度」场景的独特样本，把统一战线从「对敌策略」物化为「政权成分设计」。

mode_evidence.陈毅_instantiation: 「诗军外交身份重构」——把模式 31「识别框架→正向/负向→重构」用于外交身份与符号的重新框定：将外界对「共产党将军=强硬/不可测」的既有框架，重构为「文化使者/元帅诗人」单一新框架——以《陈毅诗稿》《赞金字塔》等诗词、书法、豪爽幽默作「非官方外交货币」，先以文化共鸣实现「破冰」，再转入政治对话，最终达成外交突围。万隆/日内瓦/联大舞台上，他故意以诗人、文人身份开场（苏加诺评「与你谈话最轻松」），把「谈判桌的硬框架」替换为「诗酒唱和的软框架」，正是模式 31「同一对象、不同表述导致不同选择」的外交级应用。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与常规「谈判框架/营销文案」用法（正负向重构同一议题）不同，陈毅把模式 31 用于「身份框架的跨域重构 + 文化符号破冰」——其重构对象不是「某个议题的措辞」，而是「谈判对手对自己的整幅认知图式」，且用诗歌这一文化符号作软性介质。他是 Protreptic 中模式 31 在「文化外交/身份重构破冰」场景的罕见标杆，且把框架效应从「话说得好听」升维为「用文化符号重建关系起点」。

mode_evidence.mode_name: 多元思维模型 / Mental Models
mode_evidence.陈毅_instantiation: 「军政文核心能力迁移矩阵」——把模式 17「跨学科学习→逆向思维→能力圈→多元模型」用于领导者自身的跨域能力复用：建立「军事指挥→政治建设→经济管理→文化传播→外交谈判」五域能力的「核心能力迁移矩阵」，同一批人的才干在五个领域互相迁移——三年游击战的韧性用于外交谈判的定力，根据地经济建设的统筹用于上海城市治理，诗词修养与幽默感用于外交破冰。其「元帅外交部长」本身就是「军事模型+政治模型+文化模型」三模型叠加的产物，不靠另起炉灶，而是把既有能力圈主动扩张到新域。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与华罗庚（同为模式 17 人选，把多元模型用于「数学工具箱降维开放给外行」）不同，陈毅把模式 17 用于「个人/组织跨域领导能力的迁移复用」——华的多元模型是「知识工具的外包」，陈的多元模型是「领导才干的内化跨域」。他是 Protreptic 中模式 17 在「军政文跨界人才能力迁移」场景的独特样本，提供「军政文三位一体跨界领导」这一罕见范式（其他人物多为单一领域深耕，少有五域贯通者）。

proposed_steps: 第1步（模式 16 游击战十六字诀）：空间织网连片——在弱势碎片化环境中，用「敌进我退保核心→敌驻我扰断补给→敌疲我打建政权→敌退我追连成片」四阶段，把战术机动转译为根据地生长方程
第2步（模式 22 总体性思维）：四位一体闭环——把政权/武装/经济/文化四系统耦合为正反馈闭环（政权供人→武装保政→经济养武→文化凝心），使敌后根据地能自我循环、自我造血
第3步（模式 6 统一战线法）：三三制包容最大化——以共产党/进步分子/中间派各 1/3 的政权组成 + 抗日联合会式广泛团结，把政治包容度物化为政权结构本身
第4步（模式 31 框架效应法）：诗军外交身份重构——把「将军」框架重构为「文化使者」，用诗词/书法/幽默作非官方外交货币，先文化破冰、再政治对话、后外交突围
第5步（模式 17 多元思维模型）：军政文能力迁移矩阵——把军事/政治/经济/文化/外交五域能力建迁移矩阵，同一才干跨域复制，固化「军政文跨界领导」范式
expected: 苏北/华中抗日根据地以「三三制」政权 + 正规军/地方武装/民兵三结合 + 经济合作社 + 抗日剧团文化动员，成为华中敌后抗战枢纽（盐城师院学报、党史文献研究院互证）
新四军苏南/苏北根据地开辟与华东野战军（三野）建制，淮海、渡江战役组织，证明十六字诀可升维为「连片根据地 + 大兵团作战」的空间治理产出
任外长 14 年，万隆（1955，周恩来主要助手）、第二次日内瓦会议（1961，老挝问题协议）、1965 北京记者招待会，确立「元帅外交」风格与诗军外交破冰范式
以《陈毅诗词集》《赞金字塔》等作文化符号、苏加诺「与你谈话最轻松」评价，实证框架效应法在「身份重构 + 文化破冰」上的可复用性
模式 16 补强「游击根据地建设」（与粟裕纯作战互补）；模式 22/6 低频补强「敌后社会治理/基层政权包容」；模式 31/17 提供「文化外交破冰」「军政文跨界」罕见范式
applications: 弱势碎片化环境下的空间治理（用机动换空间、以空间养政权，连片生长算法）
被封锁社会的自我循环系统设计（政权/武装/经济/文化四支柱正反馈闭环）
基层政权的政治包容度设计（三三制式成分结构，把统一战线物化为政权组成）
高对抗场景的软性破冰（以文化符号/身份重构替代硬谈判，文化破冰→政治对话）
跨界领导者的能力迁移（军事/政治/经济/文化/外交五域才干迁移矩阵）
组织品牌的双重框架管理（将军的硬实力 + 诗人的软符号，刚柔并济的外交/谈判人格）

distinctiveness.vs_粟裕: 粟裕（P0）把模式 16 用于非对称作战的完整范式（歼灭战、战役级机动）；陈毅把模式 16 从「作战」升维为「根据地空间织网/连片算法」。二人同是华东战场核心、同用十六字诀，但粟裕的产出是胜仗、陈毅的产出是连片政权地图，互补不重叠——粟裕打天下、陈毅建天下。
distinctiveness.vs_毛泽东: 毛泽东是模式 16 的战略提出者与游击战总方针制定者、模式 22 的全局系统思维代表；陈毅是这两项在「苏北/华中敌后根据地」这一具体中观场景的落地者——毛定方针于顶层，陈把方针工程化为「四系统闭环 + 空间织网」的可操作施工图。
distinctiveness.vs_刘少奇/周恩来(模式6): 刘少奇用模式 6 做「党内安内 + 党外攘外」双重统战，周恩来用模式 6 做国际多边统战；陈毅用模式 6 做「根据地基层政权的三三制成分设计」。同是统一战线法，陈把统战从「对敌策略」下沉为「政权内部组成结构」，场景独特。
distinctiveness.vs_竺可桢(模式22): 竺可桢用模式 22 做「科教观测网络 + 气候-农业系统耦合」；陈毅用模式 22 做「敌后根据地的社会四支柱闭环」。二人共证「系统耦合」，但竺的对象是科学观测体系、陈的对象是被封锁社会的自我存续，分处科教与战时治理两端。
distinctiveness.vs_华罗庚(模式17): 华罗庚用模式 17 把数学多元模型「降维开放给外行」；陈毅用模式 17 把个人军政文才干「跨域内化迁移」。华的多元模型是知识工具外包、陈的多元模型是领导能力内化，角度互补——一外放一内用。
distinctiveness.exclusive_contribution: Protreptic 中唯一把「游击战十六字诀(模式16)+总体性思维(模式22)+统一战线法(模式6)+框架效应法(模式31)+多元思维模型(模式17)」熔于一炉的人物；模式 16 在「游击根据地建设」场景补强（与粟裕纯作战互补），模式 22/6 在「敌后社会治理/基层政权包容」低频补强，模式 31/17 提供「文化外交破冰」「军政文跨界领导」两处罕见范式；其「空间织网→系统治理→政治包容→文化破冰→跨域复用」五环是军政文一体化领导的完整范本。

caveats: 研究文档 candidates_v2_research.md 将陈毅标注为「山东游击战创建者」，史实应修正为：山东抗日根据地主力由罗荣桓率八路军 115 师创建；陈毅的「四位一体」根据地建设实践主在苏北/华中（新四军），其 1945 后任山东军区司令员系部队北移后的整编职务。本文件据此以「苏北/华中」为准，避免以讹传讹。
陈毅的军事业绩（华东野战军、淮海/渡江战役）属「作战指挥」层面，与本题映射的「十六字诀→空间织网」「四位一体治理」「诗军外交」思维模式链是不同层面，勿将大兵团作战战果直接等同于某思维模式的实例化证据。
「诗军外交」「元帅诗人」等表述源自陈毅诗词原作与当事人口述（如苏加诺「与你谈话最轻松」），属文化外交风格的概括性归纳；相关轶事（幽默破冰、赠巴厘短剑等）多来自传记与报刊记述，引用时宜标注「据传记/外交史料」而非严格档案考据。
1965 北京记者招待会、第二次日内瓦会议等外交事件的细节来自外交部官网与党史文献，涉及文革与评价敏感处宜以官方定论为边界，不使用未经定论的私下叙述。
「三三制」「抗日联合会」「公债/合作社/统购统销」等制度的成熟是渐进过程，部分表述宜标注历史时期（主要集中于 1941-1945 华中敌后），避免把后期成型制度全部归于单一时点。

H-XMQ-299.description: Xue Muqiao（1904-2005）：薛暮桥将「价格=信息+激励」的信息论视角引入计划经济改革：提出「价格双轨制」(计划价+市场价并存)、「价值规律是社会主义经济规律」，并首创用「损失厌恶」框架解释改革阻力——改革创造的收益是分散的、长期的，而损失是集中的、即时的，因此必须设计「补偿机制」与「渐进容错」来对冲损失厌恶。其「必要的损失vs不必要的损失」区分，成为改革风险决策的核心启发式。

steps: Step 1: 损失账单建模——用「损失厌恶思维」(模式26)列出改革各利益相关方的「即时损失清单」（量化金额/权力/地位损失），识别「集中损失群体」
Step 2: 补偿机制设计——用「边际思维」(模式19)设计「针对性补偿/过渡安置/利益分享」，使损失群体边际收益≥边际损失

Step 4: 信息流速监测——用「驿站制/信息流速」(模式41)建立「价格信号→企业决策→资源重配→反馈中央」高频反馈回路，将改革信号传递延迟压缩至月度级
Step 5: 必要损失区分——建立「必要的损失(制度转型必经)vs不必要的损失(设计失误/执行偏差)」判别标准，动态调整改革节奏

H-TJY-344.reason: Tian Jiyun promoted fiscal contracting responsibility system. Gradual Reform (Mode 8): pilot-first. Crossing River by Feeling Stones (Mode 38): Three Favorables evaluation. Seek Truth from Facts (Mode 5): revenue increase and expenditure reduction, incentive mechanisms, local enthusiasm. Procedural Justice (Mode 32): fiscal contracting written into law, hierarchical fiscal system established.
steps: Step 1: Fiscal contracting pilots - Shandong, Jiangsu etc. fiscal contracting to household
Step 2: Red-green light evaluation - revenue increase expenditure reduction, incentive mechanisms, local enthusiasm
Step 3: Experience solidification - summarize contracting experience, form fiscal system reform documents
Step 4: Gradual rollout - from pilot provinces nationwide
Step 5: Institutionalization - fiscal contracting written into law, establish hierarchical fiscal system
Step 6: Dynamic adjustment - adjust sharing ratios, expenditure responsibilities based on economic development
expected: Mobilize local fiscal enthusiasm
Establish hierarchical fiscal system
Form gradual fiscal reform methodology
H-TJY-344.case: Fiscal contracting pilots in Shandong, Jiangsu etc. Three Favorables evaluation of contracting effects. Fiscal contracting written into law, hierarchical fiscal system established. Modern applications: fiscal system reform, hierarchical fiscal system, gradual reform.

H-CY-346.name: Chen Yun: Birdcage Economy / Market in Plan / Financial Discipline Iron Abacus
H-CY-346.description: Economic System Design, Plan and Market, Financial Discipline
H-CY-346.reason: Chen Yun proposed 'Birdcage Economy': market is bird, plan is cage, bird flies in cage. Birdcage Economy/Boundary Thinking (Mode 39): precisely defines market-plan boundary. Seek Truth from Facts (Mode 5): 'not from books, not from superiors, only from reality', opposing Great Leap Forward exaggeration. Procedural Justice (Mode 32): financial discipline, audit supervision, procedural compliance.
steps: Step 1: Set cage boundaries - define mandatory planned indicators (grain/cotton/oil, construction scale, credit scale)
Step 2: Fly bird in cage - guidance indicators (light industry, commerce, services) market-regulated
Step 3: Dynamic adjustment - adjust cage size and mesh density based on economic operations
Step 4: Financial discipline - audit supervision, budget constraints, violations punished
Step 5: Boundary thinking - neither full planning nor complete liberalization
Step 6: Experience solidification - form inheritable macro-control methodology
expected: Avoid both planning rigidity and market失控
Establish hard constraint of financial discipline
Form China-characteristic macro-control methodology
H-CY-346.case: 1950s Chen Yun chaired economic work: 'Market in plan'. 1956 'On Grain Purchase Issues' proposed birdcage metaphor. 1979 chaired financial work: 'Birdcage should be appropriately larger'. Modern applications: macro-prudential management, regulatory sandboxes, financial opening pace, SOE reform boundaries.

H-LXN-347.name: Li Xiannian
H-LXN-347.name_zh: 李先念：「铁算盘」经济统筹、根据地币制创新与「以稳促建」宏观调控范式
H-LXN-347.name_en: Li Xiannian: The 'Iron Abacus' Economic Coordination, Base-Area Currency Innovation and the 'Stability-First Development' Macro-Control Paradigm
H-LXN-347.unique_thinking: 「铁算盘」宏观调控范式：以「系统思维法」(模式 39) 创立「全国经济一盘棋」——把分散的根据地财政统一为中央统筹的大系统，用「整体视角→系统分析→动态平衡→优化」建立全国财政预算、税收与支出的统一框架，在建国初期百废待兴中用「铁算盘」精神精打细算每一笔预算，把经济从战后废墟升维为可计划、可调控的有机体；以「矛盾分析法」(模式 5) 精准识别建国初期的核心矛盾——通货膨胀与财政赤字，用「抓主要矛盾→找关键变量→解决核心冲突」的逻辑锁定「物价飞涨」为头号敌人，以统一财经（1950 年《关于统一国家财政经济工作的决定》）为突破口，把「收支平衡→币值稳定→物价回落」作为经济治理的核心目标；以「历史循环律监测法」（模式 32）将历朝「其兴也勤俭、其亡也奢靡」的历史规律转化为可监测的「组织健康度指标」（粮棉产量、税收比、工资增长），建立经济数据的预警体系，把历史周期律从经验判断升维为可操作的经济监测；以「动态平衡法」(模式 40) 在改革中保持灵活——面对改革开放初期的通胀压力，用「摸着石头过河」的渐进式思维，在价格双轨制中保持宏观稳定，以「边改革、边治理、边发展」的动态平衡策略实现经济转型期的软着陆。四环咬合为「系统统筹→矛盾定位→周期监测→动态平衡」的经济治理范式，是 Protreptic 中「财政统筹与经济安全」的核心标杆。
source_refs: 《李先念文选》（人民出版社）— 建国初期经济决策、财政统一、物价治理的一手文献，含其关于统一财经、平抑物价的核心论述
中共中央党史和文献研究院《李先念传》（当代中国出版社）— 权威生平：1909 生于湖北黄安、红军时期鄂豫皖根据地财政局长、建国后政务院副总理兼财政部长、国家主席，1988 年当选为中华人民共和国主席
《建国以来李先念同志在经济工作中的一系列重要论述》— 关于统一全国财经、稳定物价、财政预算的讲话原文，是「铁算盘」精神的直接来源
人民网·中国共产党新闻网《李先念：「铁算盘」的财政生涯》— 详述其从苏区财政局长到国家主席的经济治理历程
《中华人民共和国经济史》— 1950 年统一财经、打击投机倒把、稳定物价的历史记录，佐证李先念在财政统一中的核心角色
key_facts: 1909-06-02 生于湖北黄安（今红安），农家出身，自幼接触民间经济活动
红军时期任鄂豫皖特区革命军事委员会财政局长（1931-1932），在极端困难条件下建立根据地货币体系和财政制度，被誉为「铁算盘」
抗日战争时期任八路军129师386旅副旅长兼政治委员、新四军第五师师长兼政委，主持创建鄂豫边抗日根据地的经济工作
解放战争时期任中原军区副司令员，参与中原突围；后任华北财经委员会主任
建国后历任中央人民政府委员、政务院副总理兼财政部长（1949-1954）、国家计划委员会副主任
1950 年主导统一全国财经工作，发布《关于统一国家财政经济工作的决定》，实现财政收支平衡、物资调配统一、现金管理集中，迅速遏制建国初期恶性通货膨胀
1954 年任国务院副总理，长期主管国家经济工作，负责财政、工业、交通等核心领域
1983 年当选为中华人民共和国主席（1983-1988），在改革开放初期继续发挥经济治理经验

mode_evidence.李先念_instantiation: 「全国经济一盘棋」——把模式 39（系统思维法在李先念语境下的编号）用于全国财政经济大系统的统筹：把分散在各根据地的财政、税收、物资调配统一为中央集中管理的「全国一盘棋」体系，用「整体视角→系统分析→动态平衡→优化」建立统一的财政预算制度、税收征管体系和物资调配机制。1950 年《关于统一国家财政经济工作的决定》的核心内容——统一全国财政收支、物资调度、现金管理，正是系统思维在建国初期经济治理中的工程化展开。他以「铁算盘」精神精打细算每一笔预算，把战后废墟中的经济升维为可计划、可调控的有机体。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与伊本·赫勒敦（模式 12 用于文明兴衰系统）、诸葛亮（模式 12/39 用于军事经济大系统）不同：李先念把系统思维用于「国家财政经济的日常运营管理」——他的对象不是抽象的文明周期或军事后勤，而是具体的「全国财政收支系统」。他是 Protreptic 中模式 39 在「国家经济管理」层的独特样本，以「铁算盘」精神把系统思维化为精打细算的财政纪律。

mode_evidence.李先念_instantiation: 「抓物价这个主要矛盾」——把模式 5「识别核心矛盾→找关键变量→解决冲突」用于建国初期的经济治理：精准锁定「恶性通货膨胀与财政赤字」为核心矛盾，以统一财经为突破口——集中财政收入、统一物资调配、统管现金流动，实现「收支平衡→币值稳定→物价回落」的治理目标。他的工作方法论是：先识别矛盾（通货膨胀），再找关键变量（财政收支失衡），最后以统一财经解决核心冲突。这一矛盾分析框架直接产出 1950 年物价稳定、经济秩序恢复的实际效果。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与毛泽东（模式 5 用于政治/军事矛盾分析）和邓小平（模式 5 用于改革开放的矛盾判断）不同：李先念把矛盾分析用于「经济运行的具体变量」——他的矛盾不是阶级关系或路线分歧，而是通货膨胀与财政赤字的经济学核心矛盾。他是 Protreptic 中模式 5 在「宏观经济治理」层的独特样本，把矛盾分析法从政治哲学转化为经济操作。

mode_evidence.mode_name: 历史循环律监测法 / Historical Cycle Monitoring
mode_evidence.李先念_instantiation: 「勤俭兴、奢靡亡」的经济指标化——把模式 32「识别周期规律→建立监测指标→预警干预」用于经济治理：将历朝「其兴也勤俭、其亡也奢靡」的历史周期律转化为可监测的「经济健康度指标」（粮棉产量、税收比、工资增长、财政盈余），建立基于数据的经济预警体系。他在长期主持国家经济工作中强调「精打细算」「量入为出」，把历史经验从定性判断升维为定量监测——以财政收支平衡、物价稳定作为「勤俭」的量化指标，以赤字扩大、货币超发作为「奢靡/衰败」的前瞻信号。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与伊本·赫勒敦（模式 32 用于文明盛衰周期）、黄炎培（历史周期律的「组织健康度」指标）不同：李先念把监测法用于「国家宏观经济运行的日常指标体系」——他的对象不是文明周期或组织兴衰，而是具体的经济指标（物价、财政收支）。他是 Protreptic 中模式 32 在「宏观经济预警」层的独特样本，把历史周期律从哲学判断转化为经济学监测。

mode_evidence.李先念_instantiation: 「摸着石头过河」的渐进治理——把模式 40「在变化中保持平衡→灵活调整策略」用于改革开放初期的经济治理：面对价格双轨制的复杂局面，采取「边改革、边治理、边发展」的渐进式策略——在推进市场化改革的同时，用财政手段保持宏观稳定；在放开部分价格管制的同时，以「铁算盘」精神控制财政赤字和货币发行量。他的动态平衡不是被动适应，而是主动在改革的冲击中寻找新的稳态——以渐进方式实现从计划经济向市场经济的过渡，避免休克疗法式的剧烈震荡。
mode_evidence.distinctive_angle: 与邓小平（模式 40 用于改革开放整体策略）不同：李先念把动态平衡用于「具体经济领域的渐进治理」——他的对象不是整体改革路线，而是财政、物价、工业等具体经济领域在转型期的稳定运营。他是 Protreptic 中模式 40 在「经济转型期治理」层的独特样本，以「铁算盘」精神把渐进改革化为可操作的财政平衡策略。

proposed_steps: 第1步（模式 39 系统思维法）：全国经济一盘棋——把分散的财政统一为中央集中管理的大系统，建立统一的预算制度、税收体系和物资调配机制
第2步（模式 5 矛盾分析法）：抓物价核心矛盾——识别通货膨胀为头号敌人，以统一财经（收支平衡→物资集中→现金管理）为突破口
第3步（模式 32 历史循环律监测法）：经济健康度预警体系——将「勤俭兴奢靡亡」的历史规律转化为可监测的定量指标（粮棉产量、税收比、财政盈余）
第4步（模式 40 动态平衡法）：渐进改革中的宏观稳定——在价格双轨制中保持财政纪律，以「边改革、边治理」实现经济转型的软着陆
第5步（范式固化）：铁算盘财政哲学——以「系统统筹→矛盾定位→周期监测→动态平衡」四环为可传承的经济治理框架，提供国家经济管理的操作范式
expected: 1950 年统一全国财经，发布《关于统一国家财政经济工作的决定》，实现财政收支平衡、物价稳定
建立全国统一的预算制度、税收征管体系和物资调配机制，奠定新中国财政体系基础
长期主持国家经济工作（1949-1980s），在财政、工业、交通等核心领域形成「铁算盘」治理风格
在改革开放初期继续发挥经济管理经验，以渐进方式保持宏观经济稳定
applications: 国家财政经济的系统统筹（统一收支、物资调配、现金管理的大框架）
宏观经济核心矛盾的识别与解决（以矛盾分析锁定关键变量，制定针对性治理策略）
经济健康度预警体系的建立（将历史经验转化为可监测的定量指标）
经济转型期的渐进治理（在改革冲击中保持宏观稳定，避免剧烈震荡）
财政纪律与精打细算的制度化（铁算盘精神作为经济管理的核心文化）

distinctiveness.vs_伊本·赫勒敦(模式39): 伊本·赫勒敦用系统思维建「文明兴衰的元模型」；李先念把系统思维用于「国家财政经济的日常运营管理」。前者是抽象的文明周期模型，后者是具体的经济管理系统——层位不同、对象不同。
distinctiveness.vs_毛泽东(模式5): 毛泽东用矛盾分析处理「政治路线与阶级关系」；李先念把矛盾分析用于「通货膨胀与财政赤字」的具体经济变量。同是矛盾分析，毛的落点是政治战略，李的落点是宏观经济操作——角度互补。
distinctiveness.vs_黄炎培(模式32): 黄炎培把历史周期律转化为「组织健康度指标」（其兴也勤俭其亡也奢靡）；李先念把监测法用于「国家宏观经济运行的日常指标体系」。黄关注组织兴衰，李关注经济数据——互补不重叠。
distinctiveness.vs_邓小平(模式40): 邓小平把动态平衡用于「改革开放整体策略」；李先念把动态平衡用于「具体经济领域的渐进治理」。邓关注路线选择，李关注财政纪律——层次不同、对象不同。
distinctiveness.exclusive_contribution: Protreptic 中唯一把「系统统筹(模式39)+矛盾分析(模式5)+周期监测(模式32)+动态平衡(模式40)」熔于一炉的经济治理人物；以「铁算盘」精神把系统思维化为财政纪律、把矛盾分析转化为经济操作、把历史周期律升维为监测指标、把动态平衡落实为渐进改革——其「系统统筹→矛盾定位→周期监测→动态平衡」四环是经济治理的完整范式，填补了 Protreptic 中「国家经济管理」层的空白。

caveats: 「铁算盘」是民间对李先念经济工作风格的概括性评价，非其自述；引用时宜标注「据传记/经济史料」
1950 年统一财经的具体执行涉及全国各级政府的复杂协调过程，实际效果是渐进实现的，非一纸文件立竿见影
李先念的经济治理经验主要形成于计划经济时期，其「铁算盘」风格在改革开放后的市场经济环境中需要适应性调整
「摸着石头过河」虽是邓小平的著名表述，但李先念在改革开放初期的经济治理中确实体现了渐进式动态平衡的思路——应标注此为对其工作风格的概括，非其原话
李先念在文革期间受到冲击（1967年被错误批判），其经济治理的连续性被打断，本卡聚焦其经济贡献，不对其政治遭遇做过多展开

H-LXN-001.name: Li Xiannian
H-LXN-001.core_mode: M7 战略预判法/Marginal Thinking/摸石头过河/M34制度化制衡
H-LXN-001.intellectual_tradition: 中国近现代政治经济思维
H-LXN-001.description_en: Li Xiannian（1901-1997）： Chinese political economist who dedicated himself to constructing China's economic system reform and strategic forecasting system. He advocated identifying key leverage points of economic and social development through strategic forecasting method, analyzing marginal efficiency of resource allocation with marginal thinking, advancing reform pilots with the 'crossing the river by feeling for stones' incremental exploration method, and ensuring reform sustainability through institutionalized checks and balances. His thought permeates the Chinese modern process, combining theoretical height with practical depth, and is an important case for understanding China's thinking modes during the economic transition period.
H-LXN-001.reason_en: Core thinking modes: M7(Strategic Forecasting Method), M19(Marginal Thinking), M38(Crossing the River by Feeling for Stones), M39(Birdcage Economy), M34(Institutionalized Checks and Balances). Li Xiannian identified key leverage points of economic and social development through strategic forecasting method, analyzed marginal efficiency of resource allocation with marginal thinking, advanced reform pilots with incremental 'crossing the river by feeling for stones' approach, and ensured reform sustainability through institutionalized checks and balances. His thought permeates the Chinese modern process, combining theoretical height with practical depth.
steps_en: Step 1: Identify Core Observation Points — Use 'Strategic Forecasting Method' (Mode 7) to lock in key variables of China's economic transition, determining 'industrialization process, population structure change, market allocation' three core observation points

Step 2: Modular Marginal Analysis — Use 'Marginal Thinking' (Mode 19) to decompose economic system reform into 'marginal cost, marginal benefit, marginal risk' three-dimensional evaluation system, establish dynamic monitoring mechanism

Step 3: Strategy for Crossing the River — Use 'Crossing the River by Feeling for Stones' (Mode 38) to design 'small pilot → review and expand → full implementation' three-stage pilot rhythm, with 'pilot result hard indicators' as traffic lights

Step 4: Institutional Lock-in of Ecosystem — Use 'Institutionalized Checks and Balances' (Mode 34) to promote 'decision procedures, supervision mechanisms, responsibility assignment' three institutional norms to take root, with standards defining the ecosystem and preventing lock-in
Step 5: Case Accumulation and Transfer — Summarize reform experiences with a global perspective, forming a library of可迁移 Chinese economic transition benchmark cases
expected_en: Establish resource allocation evaluation mechanism under marginal thinking
Form replicable economic transition pilot experiences
Promote institutionalization of economic system reform
H-LXN-001.case_en: 1980-1990s China's economic system reform practice: Li Xiannian led a economic team from planned economy to market economy. Strategic Forecasting: Identifying key reform variables (price reform, enterprise system, market rules). Marginal Analysis: Calculating reform marginal costs and benefits, optimizing resource allocation paths. Crossing the River by Feeling for Stones: Designing small-scale system pilots (special zone exploration → provincial expansion), adjusting plans based on results. Institutional Checks and Balances: Establishing reform supervision mechanisms, ensuring decision procedures are compliant and responsibilities are clear. Reform outcomes: Liberating productive forces, improving resource allocation efficiency, promoting continuous and healthy economic development.

JP-LEAN-001.name_en: Honda Soichiro: From Mechanic to Racing Champion — the 'Technology Feeds Management' System and Innovation-Driven Paradigm
JP-LEAN-001.description_en: Honda Soichiro (1906-1991) was one of Japan's most innovative industrialists post-war, rising from auto mechanic origins to found the world's third-largest automobile manufacturer and largest motorcycle maker Honda Motor Company. Born in Iwata, Shizuoka Prefecture to a poor family, he started as an apprentice at age 14 in Toyota Automatic Loom President Sonoko Shiro's brother's auto repair shop. Founded Honda Technical Research Institute in 1937, initially producing piston rings for Toyota. After factories were destroyed during WWII, he assembled broadcast machine parts into small motorcycles creating 'Batta' bikes (called 'cockroaches' for their cheapness), marking Honda's startup. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering a 'Technology Feeds Management' system — through repeated track validation ('the racetrack is the best laboratory'), sinking cutting-edge technology to civilian products, forming a unique 'track-to-street' technology transfer path. Honda's uniqueness lies in being a typical 'engineer-type entrepreneur', unfamiliar with finance and management theory, but creating a radically different management philosophy from Toyota Kiichiro through deep understanding of mechanics and belief in 'technology democratization' (letting ordinary people enjoy driving pleasure). He is a key sample of mode 35 (Technology-Driven Innovation) in Japanese industrial tradition and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'technology feeds management' scenarios.
JP-LEAN-001.reason_en: Honda Soichiro fills Protreptic's Japanese gap in 'technology feeds management'. He is the only complete Japanese sample of mode 35 (Technology-Driven Innovation) in 'track-to-street' technology transfer scenarios, demonstrating how F1 and MotoGP racing repeated validation sinks cutting-edge technology to civilian products; also the sole Japanese representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'engineer-type entrepreneur' scenarios. His technology democratization philosophy ('let ordinary people enjoy driving pleasure') and 'racetrack is the best laboratory' thinking have profound heuristic value for modern product innovation and management models.
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 35 Technology-Driven Innovation): Piston ring to motorcycle technology transformation — developing high-quality piston rings from Toyota Automatic Loom scrap, post-war assembling broadcast machine parts into small motorcycles creating Batta bikes at minimal cost meeting Japan's post-war mobility needs

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Track-to-street technology feedback system — establishing 'racetrack is laboratory, racing is validation' engineering philosophy through Super Sport team participating in international events (1960s MotoGP), sinking track-validated technology to civilian motorcycle and automobile product lines

Step 3 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Motorcycle-to-automobile technology expansion — entering F1 with 360cc racing car in 1963 (Honda RA271 won at 1965 US Grand Prix), extending engine technology accumulated in motorcycle field to automobile manufacturing, establishing 'power core' competitive advantage

Step 4 (Mode 15 Framing Effect): Technology democratization brand framework — creating 'Everyman's Dream' and 'The Power of Dreams' brand slogans, framing technical advantages as democratization philosophy of 'letting ordinary people enjoy driving pleasure', forming sharp contrast with Toyota Kiichiro's lean manufacturing philosophy

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Engineer-type entrepreneur model — condensing 'technology development → track validation → civilian feedback → brand framework' into an operable innovation-driven template, proving that engineers unfamiliar with management can build world-class enterprises through technical faith and product quality
expected_en: Master Honda Soichiro's technology expansion path from piston rings to automobile manufacturing and the operational mechanism of his track-feedback system
Understand philosophical differences between 'engineer-type entrepreneurs' (Honda) and 'manager-type entrepreneurs' (Toyota Kiichiro) and their organizational impact
Evaluate the continuing heuristic value of his technology democratization philosophy and track-validation model for modern product innovation
JP-LEAN-001.case_en: Born 1906 in Horigitte, Iwata, Shizuoka Prefecture to blacksmith parents. Entered Toyota Automatic Loom President Sonoko Shiro's brother's auto repair shop as apprentice at 14. Founded Automatic Loom Works in 1928, developing high-quality piston rings for Toyota. Established Honda Technical Research Institute in 1937, producing piston rings obtaining Toyota orders. Factories destroyed by US air raids during WWII, assembled broadcast machine parts and small engines into bicycles creating Batta motorcycles — cheaply called 'cockroaches' but extremely popular. Formally established Honda Technical Research Institute in 1948, Dream D-type motorcycle released 1949. Entered US market in 1959, Super Cub successfully opened the American market. Established Super Sport team for MotoGP in 1960s, sinking track-validated technology to civilian products. Entered F1 with RA270 in 1963, RA271 won at 1965 US Grand Prix (first Japanese company F1 victory). Honda automobile sales exceeded one million in 1968. CVCC engine released 1971 meeting strict US emission standards, making Honda among the first Japanese automakers to comply with environmental regulations. Civic global sales exceeded 10 million in 1972. Stepped down as president to Kawashima Giichiro in 1983 but continued as chairman driving technology innovation. His 'racetrack is laboratory' philosophy and 'The Power of Dreams' brand slogan became the core of Honda corporate culture.
JP-LEAN-001.intellectual_tradition: Self-taught Engineer / Racing Enthusiast / Technology Democratization Advocate
JP-LEAN-001.cross_cultural_impact: Honda motorcycles and automobiles became global lifestyle symbols; 'The Power of Dreams' brand philosophy adopted worldwide
JP-LEAN-001.legal_system: 無（戰後日本產業政策下的民間企業家）
JP-LEAN-001.education_tradition: 自學者（汽車修補→活塞環開發→引擎技術），從未接受正規高等教育
JP-LEAN-001.scientific_contribution: 否（但CVCC引擎是首個符合美國嚴格排放標準的汽油引擎技術突破）
JP-LEAN-001.artistic_legacy: 否（但其創立的Honda F1博物館和技術展示館支持了日本工業文化發展）
JP-LEAN-001.environmental_stewardship: 是（CVCC環保技術的開創性貢獻，Honda後來在氫燃料電池領域的領導地位）
JP-LEAN-001.gender_role_innovation: 否（但其妻子鈴木靜子在戰後協助維持公司運營）
JP-LEAN-001.diaspora_network_type: 技術（Honda全球製造和研發網絡的知識傳播）
JP-LEAN-001.digital_adaptation: 無（前數字時代，但其技術創新為後續數位化奠定了基礎）
JP-LEAN-001.regional_integration: 有（Honda全球供應鏈和製造網絡的整合者）
JP-LEAN-001.conflict_resolution_mechanism: 技術辯證（與豐田喜一郎的「精益製造 vs 技術至上」經典對話，二人共同奠定了日本汽車工業基礎）

JP-MGMT-001.name_en: Matsushita Konosuke: From Lamp Wick Maker to God of Management — the 'Waterway Philosophy' System and Social Instrument Paradigm
JP-MGMT-001.description_en: Matsushita Konosuke (1894-1989) was one of Japan's most influential management thinkers post-war, hailed as 'God of Management'. Born to a poor farming family in Ariita-gun, Wakayama Prefecture (now Ito-gun), he went to Osaka at age 8 as an apprentice, working as a string puller at Uchigami Electric Light Company. Founded Matsushita Electric Manufacturing Co. in 1918 at age 24 with 300 yen (equivalent to a worker's annual wage), producing two-prong plugs and improved incandescent lamp sockets. Post-war he founded Matsushita Electric Industrial (now Panasonic), becoming one of Japan's largest electronics manufacturers. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering a 'Social Instrument Theory' into an operable management philosophy — replacing traditional 'profit maximization' logic with 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply, making products become society's infrastructure), establishing the management principle of 'enterprise value lies not in how much money earned, but what contribution made to society'. Matsushita's uniqueness lies in having almost no formal education yet developing a systematic management thought system (the 'Panasonic Way'), including PHILosophy (Matsushita Management Philosophy), MBC (Management by Brain-cycle, brain cycle management) and IPPONGI (Fundamentalism, focusing on core values). He is a key sample of mode 37 (Social Instrument Management) in Japanese commercial tradition and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'non-traditional entrepreneur systematization' scenarios.
JP-MGMT-001.reason_en: Matsushita Konosuke fills Protreptic's Japanese gap in 'Social Instrument Management'. He is the only complete Japanese sample of mode 37 (Social Instrument Management) in 'Waterway Philosophy' scenarios, demonstrating management philosophy of positioning enterprise as social infrastructure rather than mere profit machine; also the sole Japanese representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'non-traditional entrepreneur systematization' scenarios. His 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply like tap water) and 'Social Instrument Theory' have profound heuristic value for modern ESG (environmental, social, governance) philosophy and corporate social responsibility theory.
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 37 Social Instrument Management): Waterway Philosophy creation — proposing core thesis 'enterprise value lies not in money earned but contribution to society', positioning products as social infrastructure that should be mass-produced and cheaply supplied like tap water

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Panasonic Way systematization — creating PHILosophy (Matsushita Management Philosophy: properly use electricity, promote social prosperity, elevate cultural level), MBC (Management by Brain-cycle: information collection → analysis → decision execution → feedback correction closed loop) and IPPONGI (Fundamentalism, focusing on core values without deviating from original purpose)

Step 3 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Product category expansion from plugs to full range — starting with two-prong plugs, gradually expanding to radios, fans, TVs, refrigerators and full household appliance categories, establishing 'multi-category small-batch' flexible production model

Step 4 (Mode 15 Framing Effect): Social instrument brand framework — redefining enterprise existence meaning through 'social instrument' concept, framing business success as social contribution rather than mere profit acquisition, creating 'management as spiritual practice' brand narrative

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Non-traditional entrepreneur system — condensing 'Waterway Philosophy → Panasonic Way → Social Instrument Theory → Management as Spiritual Practice' into an operable management template, proving that a farmer's son without formal education can build world-class enterprise through practical wisdom
expected_en: Master Matsushita Konosuke's expansion path from plugs to full household appliance categories and core logic of Waterway Philosophy
Understand Panasonic Way (PHILosophy, MBC, IPPONGI) systematic structure and its heuristic value for modern management
Evaluate the continuing heuristic value of his Social Instrument Theory and Management as Spiritual Practice philosophy for ESG concepts and corporate social responsibility
JP-MGMT-001.case_en: Born 1894 to poor farming family in Kujima, Ariita-gun, Wakayama Prefecture, eighth of seven brothers. Went to Osaka at 8 (1902) as apprentice at Uchigami Electric Light Company, earning only 30 yen monthly. Resigned in 1912 to work at Oki Shoten (electrical component wholesaler) in Osaka, responsible for selling incandescent lamp sockets. Founded Matsushita Electric Manufacturing Co. in 1928 with savings of 300 yen and wife Shige's dowry jewelry, producing improved two-prong plugs and lamp sockets. Kanto Great Earthquake of 1923 brought massive orders, rapidly expanding the company. Survived 1929 Great Depression through belief in 'even during bad times must continue operating'. Established Matsushita Electric Industrial Co. Ltd in 1932, began producing radios and fans. During WWII converted to military supplies (air raid headlamps, batteries). Rebuilt Matsushita Electric Industrial in 1946, began producing TVs and refrigerators. Established 'multi-category small-batch' flexible production model in 1950s, becoming Japan's home appliance giant. Proposed 'Social Instrument Theory' in 1959 — enterprises are society's public property, managers' responsibility is to contribute to society. Founded Matsushita Seikei Juku (training institution for politicians and entrepreneurs) in 1964. Retired in 1973, succeeded by son Matsushita Masato as president. His 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply like tap water) and 'Social Instrument Theory' became one of the core paradigms of Japanese management studies; Panasonic Way (PHILosophy + MBC + IPPONGI) widely applied in modern management education.
JP-MGMT-001.intellectual_tradition: Self-taught Management Philosopher / Social Instrument Theory Advocate
JP-MGMT-001.cross_cultural_impact: Panasonic Way taught at management schools worldwide; 'Social Instrument Theory' predates modern ESG concepts by decades
JP-MGMT-001.legal_system: 無（戰後日本產業政策下的民間企業家）
JP-MGMT-001.education_tradition: 自學者（僅讀完小學，後通過實踐和管理哲學建立系統化經營思想）
JP-MGMT-001.scientific_contribution: 否（但其推動的消費電子普及對社會現代化有間接貢獻）
JP-MGMT-001.artistic_legacy: 否（但其創立的松下政經塾支持了日本政治和商業人才培養）
JP-MGMT-001.environmental_stewardship: 否（但Panasonic後來在環保技術領域有重要貢獻）
JP-MGMT-001.gender_role_innovation: 有限支持（妻子靜子在戰後協助維持公司運營，但當時社會對女性參與商業的認可度有限）
JP-MGMT-001.diaspora_network_type: 知識（Panasonic Way管理哲學的全球傳播）
JP-MGMT-001.digital_adaptation: 無（前數字時代，但其多品類戰略為後續數位化轉型奠定了組織基礎）
JP-MGMT-001.regional_integration: 有（Panasonic全球製造和銷售網絡的整合者）
JP-MGMT-001.conflict_resolution_mechanism: 經營辯證（與本田宗一郎的「社會公器 vs 技術創新」經典對話，二人共同奠定了日本戰後經濟奇蹟的基礎）
